benchmark_label: Cycles official public notebook clearing core (local run)
return_value: Directed graph whose edge capacities are the cyclic structure/set-offs to clear
scope_limits: This is the official open notebook implementation, not a benchmark of the hosted cycles.money product or current production solver.
Algorithm receives the whole graph in one process; it is not a neighbour-only node-local protocol.
No TEE, encryption, zero-knowledge proving, blockchain submission, finality, signatures or network transport is included.
No actual Cycles production communication count or byte overhead is exposed by this notebook; report it as unmeasured, not zero.
Only fixed cancellation-only obligation snapshots with uniform cost1 and no external liquidity/acceptance edges are comparable to corresponding LedgerLoops runs.
No published versioned production service endpoint with benchmark access was established by this discovery.
